quotes.C2: The model never picks the owner. It reports owner mentions as written; code does the roster matching
quotes.C3: Files are grouped by the phase that creates them (P1–P5). Later phases edit earlier files, and the phase sections say which.
quotes.C4: ≥ 95% found; 0 wrong confident owners; 0 wrong confident dates and no dates on vague items; Quote not found < 2%

strength: The model only reports raw owner references and date phrases, and ordinary code does roster matching, date resolution, quote verification and the owner-in-quote check. This, plus a real-API eval with launch bars ("0 wrong confident owners"), targets R6: flag rather than guess, and measure it against the 34% baseline.
weakness: Scope and timeline. The 2-week deadline (R14) is never mentioned, yet v1 includes draft locks with heartbeat and take-over, a minimap, speaker mapping, a stats page, meeting delete, undo toasts and a re-paste hash guard. That is far more than the brief asks for in two weeks. Hinglish (R3) is also missing from the prompt, the eval set and the risk list.
errors: Privacy conflict with R7: the plan commits Aman's 10 real labelled meetings to eval/cases/ in the GitHub repo. That keeps raw confidential notes indefinitely, beyond the 30-day deletion rule; a private repo does not fix this.

The plan picks Workers Paid ($5/month) without explaining why the free tier won't do, even though free-tier hosting was preferred. D1, Cron Triggers and Workflows are all offered on the Workers Free plan.
The worst-case budget is $5 hosting + a $15 Anthropic cap = $20, which is at the ceiling, not under it (spec says "~$10–20"). Paid eval runs ($2–4 each) count against the same $15 cap.
max_tokens 32000 with adaptive thinking: thinking tokens count toward max_tokens. On long 15K-word transcripts, a max_tokens stop is treated as a final non-retryable failure instead of being handled.
After 30 days, verbatim quotes from the notes are kept on items. This goes slightly beyond "only the action items are kept" (R7).
Inconsistency: spec §14 step 4 still tells Aman to enter ALLOWED_DOMAIN in the dashboard, but plan decision 3 moves it to wrangler.jsonc.
Hinglish (R3) is not handled: fold(), normalization and fuzzy quote matching are not designed or tested for code-mixed or Devanagari text.
R15 is only partly listed: audio recording and Jira sync are not named in §17 out-of-scope, though "Pasting is the only input" implies audio is excluded.
